svg.title: Journey
svg.desc: Dec 2024: First neural net — MNIST digit recognition; Feb 2025: Deep learning series — perceptron to CNNs, in public; May 2025: ANN Intern · Planto AI — deep learning for predictive models; Jun 2025: U-Net land cover — 0.674 mIoU, later published; Aug 2025: AI/ML Mentor · Sayapatri — 100+ students, 45-hour bootcamp; Oct 2025: MLOps — MLflow · Hyperopt · XGBoost; Jan 2026: Nepal Legal Mistral 7B — LoRA fine-tune, community GGUF; Mar 2026: LegalGPT Nepal — final-year team project; Sep 2026: Nepal Law AI goes live — web app on hybrid RAG
